versions.changelog:
- Rebranded from flaw0 to MoltGuard with new purpose and identity.
- Updated description and metadata to reflect MoltGuard’s focus: protection against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and malicious commands.
- Replaced previous vulnerability scanning documentation with new setup, usage, onboarding, and command references tailored to MoltGuard.
- Added details on Core-based detection, supported protection surfaces, and plans/pricing.
- Included updated installation, test instructions, and enterprise onboarding steps.
- Provided new contact and support details.

- Major change: All source code, configuration, documentation, and example files have been removed.
- The skill structure is now empty, containing only the skill manifest (SKILL.md).
- No runtime code, tests, configuration samples, or usage scripts remain in this version.
- This update effectively decommissions the skill; it is no longer usable as a scanner.

Initial public release of flaw0: AI-powered security and vulnerability scanner for OpenClaw.

- Adds code and dependency scanning for OpenClaw codebases, plugins, and skills.
- Detects 12+ types of code vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and insecure patterns.
- Scans Node.js dependencies for known CVEs, outdated versions, and malicious packages.
- Reports results with an easy-to-understand flaw score and detailed issue breakdown.
- Supports multiple OpenClaw AI models (scan speed vs. accuracy).
- Provides fix suggestions, configuration options, and CI/CD integration guides.
